items.title: Mrs. Robert George (Mary) Hoffman Interview, 1976-02-05
items.q: Well, he and my husband were friends. So, Benny Mars used to come into the store to get professional copies to the Crest store, yeah. And, uh, so one day he came in with this man and he introduced him to me.

ctx.x: Oh, I think it was when I was still playing at the Crest Doa. He had come back to New Orleans. He was a New Orleans man, alright, but he had been off somewhere else playing. And he came back into town and, um, uh, do you remember, do you know who Benny Mars was? A, a band leader that used to direct?
Yes, I know about him. Yeah, about him.
